title: Desvigne taking up trombone, hiring Louis Armstrong in Kenner
summary: Desvigne explains he took trombone lessons when he could not find a trombonist, and hired Louis Armstrong on cornet for a job in Kenner.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: You got a real voice up.
I used to go to your house once, and you're doing the trombone. Yeah, yeah.

How did I play the trombone?

Well, I was playing the trombone. Well, how did I see the way that started? I couldn't find any trombone player or something. So it was easy to get a trumpet player. So I thought I'd go ahead and pick up on the trombone, see? And took a few lessons on the trombone. And I think one job, if I'm not mistaken, a job we played in Kenner. I think it was Kenner, Louisiana, someplace there. I hired Louis Armstrong to play. Louis Armstrong and Joe Lindsey. And I played the trombone. Louis played the cornet then, see? And I know it too, Louis. Yeah, and then I stayed playing the trombone for a while. And then, couldn't find no trumpet player. And I thought I'd go back on the trumpet again, you see?
